71inline constexpr float JOG_RUN_CRITICAL_SHARE = 0.823F;
72
81struct SpeedBandTops
82{
83 float walk = 0.0F;
84 float jog = 0.0F;
85 float run = 0.0F;
86};
87
88inline SpeedBandTops speedBandTops(float transition, float critical, float top)
89{
90 const float walkTop = std::min(transition, top);
91 const float jogTop =
92 std::clamp(JOG_RUN_CRITICAL_SHARE * critical, walkTop, top);
93 return {
94 .walk = walkTop, .jog = jogTop, .run = std::clamp(critical, jogTop, top)};
95}
96
97inline SpeedBand speedBandFrom(MovementMode mode, float transition,
98 float critical, float top)
99{
100 const SpeedBandTops tops = speedBandTops(transition, critical, top);
101 switch (mode)
102 {
103 case MovementMode::WALK:
104 return {.low = 0.0F, .high = tops.walk};
105 case MovementMode::JOG:
106 return {.low = tops.walk, .high = tops.jog};
107 case MovementMode::RUN:
108 return {.low = tops.jog, .high = tops.run};
109 case MovementMode::SPRINT:
110 return {.low = tops.run, .high = top};
111 }
112 return {.low = 0.0F, .high = tops.walk};
113}
114
117struct SpeedBandInputs
118{
119 float transition = 0.0F;
120 float critical = 0.0F;
121 float top = 0.0F;
122};
123
125inline SpeedBand speedBandFrom(MovementMode mode, const SpeedBandInputs& inputs)
126{
127 return speedBandFrom(mode, inputs.transition, inputs.critical, inputs.top);
128}

136inline float modeTargetSpeed(MovementMode mode, float distance,
137 const std::array<float, 4>& jogRamp,
138 const std::array<float, 4>& tops)
139{
140 const auto top = [&tops](MovementMode band)
141 { return tops[static_cast<std::size_t>(band)]; };
142 if (mode != MovementMode::JOG)
143 {
144 return top(mode);
145 }
146 const auto ramp = [distance](float from, float to)
147 {
148 return std::clamp((distance - from) / std::max(to - from, 1e-3F), 0.0F,
149 1.0F);
150 };
151 const float walk = top(MovementMode::WALK);
152 const float jog = top(MovementMode::JOG);
153 const float run = top(MovementMode::RUN);
154 return walk + ((jog - walk) * ramp(jogRamp[0], jogRamp[1])) +
155 ((run - jog) * ramp(jogRamp[2], jogRamp[3]));
156}
157
158inline const char* movementModeName(MovementMode mode)
159{
160 constexpr std::array<const char*, MOVEMENT_MODE_COUNT> NAMES{"walk", "jog",
161 "run", "sprint"};
162 return NAMES[static_cast<std::size_t>(mode)];
163}

400 [[nodiscard]] float getUpShare() const
401 {
402 if (!gettingUp || getUpTotalSeconds <= 0.0F)

404 return 0.0F;
405 }
406 return std::clamp(1.0F - (getUpSeconds / getUpTotalSeconds), 0.0F, 1.0F);

409 {
410 const float turns =

412 (fellOnFront ? 0.0F : 0.5F);
413 return std::cos(turns * 6.2831853F) > 0.0F;
414 }

417 return feetHeight > 0.0F || jumpSpeed > 0.0F;

799struct ContactFactor
800{
801 const char* name = "";
802 TermSource source{};
803 float value = 0.0F;
804 float angleWeight = 0.0F;
805 float weightWeight = 0.0F;
806 float verticalWeight = 0.0F;
807 float spinWeight = 0.0F;
808
809 [[nodiscard]] float weightFor(ContactJob job) const
810 {
811 return job == ContactJob::ANGLE ? angleWeight
812 : job == ContactJob::WEIGHT ? weightWeight
813 : job == ContactJob::VERTICAL ? verticalWeight
814 : spinWeight;
815 }
816};

821struct ContactAssessment
822{
825 Vector2F aim{.x = 0.0F, .y = 0.0F};
826 float intendedSpeed = 0.0F;
827 float intendedElevation = 0.0F;
830 float incomingSpeed = 0.0F;
831 bool moving = false;
832 bool rebound = false;
835 Vector2F line{.x = 0.0F, .y = 0.0F};
836 float lineElevation = 0.0F;
839 float turn = 0.0F;
840 bool outward = false;
841 float paceChange = 0.0F;
843 float verticalTurn = 0.0F;
844 std::array<ContactFactor, CONTACT_FACTOR_COUNT> factors{};
845 float angleDifficulty = 0.0F;
846 float weightDifficulty = 0.0F;
847 float verticalDifficulty = 0.0F;
849 BallSpin intendedSpin{};
850 float spinDifficulty = 0.0F;
853 float weakFootAngle = 0.0F;
854 float weakFootWeight = 0.0F;
855 float weakFootVertical = 0.0F;
856 float weakFootSpin = 0.0F;
857
859 [[nodiscard]] float added(std::size_t index, ContactJob job) const
860 {
861 if (index == WEAK_FOOT_FACTOR)
862 {
863 return job == ContactJob::ANGLE ? weakFootAngle
864 : job == ContactJob::WEIGHT ? weakFootWeight
865 : job == ContactJob::VERTICAL ? weakFootVertical
866 : weakFootSpin;
867 }
868 const ContactFactor& factor = factors[index];
869 return factor.value * factor.weightFor(job);
870 }
872 [[nodiscard]] float difficulty(ContactJob job) const
873 {
874 return job == ContactJob::ANGLE ? angleDifficulty
875 : job == ContactJob::WEIGHT ? weightDifficulty
876 : job == ContactJob::VERTICAL ? verticalDifficulty
877 : spinDifficulty;
878 }
879};
